mechanism_narrative: The sharp synchronized collapse in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES over the last week will continue to pull RETAIL_REC down over the next four weeks because fewer commuting trips reduce incidental shopping and dining stops.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not stay below its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days despite continued low TRANSIT and WORKPLACES values.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM remains more than 20 points below baseline, it marks a broad stay-at-home regime that suppresses discretionary shopping trips, causing RETAIL_REC to fall further within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to decline within 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM crosses below -20 and remains there.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in PARKS and RESIDENTIAL movement signals household caution and substitution toward home-based behavior, which reduces discretionary outings and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 28 days when PARKS falls and RESIDENTIAL rises at the same time.

mechanism_narrative: The steep week-on-week fall in TRANSIT from near baseline to far below baseline will transmit to retail activity with a one-week lag, because reduced station traffic immediately cuts walk-in demand around shopping corridors.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 15 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall in the week after a more than 15-point weekly drop in TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain deeply negative together, the combination indicates coordinated mobility restrictions or firm shutdowns, and RETAIL_REC will continue falling over four weeks because both commuter and lunch-time retail demand weaken.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain below -20.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS mobility above baseline will precede a short-lived rise in retail trips within two weeks because warmer-weather and leisure outings spill over into nearby discretionary shopping.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days after PARKS crosses above 0 and stays positive.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in RESIDENTIAL mobility combined with falling WORKPLACES means people are staying home more and commuting less, which lowers spontaneous retail visits and drives RETAIL_REC down over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not remain below its prior 4-week average when RESIDENTIAL rises while WORKPLACES falls.

mechanism_narrative: The synchronized declines across GROCERY_PHARM, PARKS, TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, and RESIDENTIAL imply broad behavioral suppression rather than a sector-specific shift, and this broad contraction will keep RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 28 days when multiple mobility categories remain broadly depressed together.
